newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Decision on Rotterdam port expansion expected soon.
newsitem.headline: Decision on Rotterdam port expansion expected soon.

text.p: A government decision on whether to push ahead with a controversial port expansion and land reclamation project in Rotterdam is expected before the beginning of July, a Netherlands Ministry of Transport spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
A decision on the Maasvlakte II project was expected late last week but was postponed to allow more discussion of the plans.
"It has still not been decided whether to chose the dry or wet option for the Maasvlakte II," the spokesman said.
The dry option involves a 500 hectare reclaimed area without a harbour while the wet option allows for a 1,000 hectare site including a harbour.
Dutch ministeries have also not decided how much land to set-aside for a nature reserve, he said.
"We are hoping these two issues can be decided before the Cabinet recess in early July."
The Dutch Ministries of Economic Affairs, Agriculture, Environment, Transport and Public Works are all involved in the debate.
Once they have agreed a plan, the proposals will be sent to the Dutch Parliament.
